# Anna Spysz

> Anna Spysz is a Developer Advocate at Stripe and a full-stack software engineer based in Portland, Oregon. She previously built serverless developer tools at AWS (Application Composer) and Stackery. She works mostly in React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, and AWS serverless, and cares a lot about good documentation and making software approachable for beginners.

Before software, Anna was a writer, editor, and Polish-to-English translator: co-author of *The Essential Guide to Being Polish* (2013) and former editor-in-chief of the Krakow Post.

## Apps

- [iffapp](https://iffapp.com): A "get-to-do" list rather than a to-do list. You get to do a thing if and only if you complete the tasks you need to do first. Built with Next.js, React, Clerk, Prisma, and Stripe.
- [Content's Not Dead](https://contentsnotdead.com): An open-source, themeable content platform monetized with Stripe subscriptions and per-content Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) payments, for humans and agents.
